newsitem.title: CUBA: Cuba, Greece sign accord for economic cooperation.
newsitem.headline: Cuba, Greece sign accord for economic cooperation.

text.p: Cuba and Greece signed on Friday an accord to set up a joint commission on cooperation in economic, scientific and technical areas, saying the agreement should help foster economic ties between the two countries.

The agreement, which follows the signing of a bilateral investment promotion and protection accord last year, was signed by Cuban Foreign Investment Minister Ibrahim Ferradaz and visiting Greek deputy National Economy Minister Alexandros Baltas.

Baltas told reporters afterward that current levels of bilateral trade were low, and there is as yet no Greek investment in Cuba. However he said there was interest by Greek firms in doing business in areas such as shipping, tourism, agriculture and industry.
